paraphrase: Not knowing and seeing the eye, forms and so on as they are, one is inflamed with lust and the five aggregates of clinging accumulate; knowing and seeing them as they are, craving is abandoned, and in such a one the noble eightfold path comes to fulfilment together with the four establishments of mindfulness and all the thirty-seven qualities, and calm and insight occur yoked evenly together.
